title: Employment Trends of Fresh Polytechnic and ITE Graduates
what_it_is: Employment Trends of Fresh Polytechnic and ITE Graduates

sections.label: Graduate employment and further studies
sections.summary: Over 10 years around nine in 10 graduates found jobs, while more polytechnic and ITE graduates chose further studies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: The employment rate has remained high over the past 10 years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Each year, subject to some fluctuations due to the performance of the economy and job market, around nine in 10 graduates found jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Over the last 10 years, the percentage of polytechnic and ITE graduates who chose to go into further studies, instead of working, has gone up by over 10 percentage points.

sections.label: Full-time permanent employment decline
sections.summary: Full-time permanent employment for polytechnic and ITE graduates fell from 77% in 2007 to 58% in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: To illustrate this, the percentage of polytechnic and ITE graduates who reported that they were in full-time permanent employment fell from 77% in 2007 to 58% in 2016, a 19-percentage point change.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: About half of the decrease is due to students choosing to do part-time work while they prepare for further studies.

sections.label: Involuntary part-time work and study
sections.summary: About one percentage point more were involuntarily doing part-time work or still looking for employment, and MOE will study these trends.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: The small remainder – about one percentage point – represents an increase in those who are involuntarily doing part-time work or are still looking for employment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: MOE will be doing an in-depth study into these trends and understanding the underlying forces driving the decisions of students.

sections.label: Trends reflect student aspirations
sections.summary: Preliminary analysis suggests the trends reflect students' behaviour, aspirations and available opportunities rather than the Member's described factors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Our preliminary analysis and the information that we have, suggest that the trends are reflective of the behaviour and aspirations of students as well as the opportunities that are being made available, rather than a specific push as a result of the factors described by the Member.
